_about: Screen x scale x runner. scripts/check-matrix.mjs reads this in CI: every Shot-Panel call in scripts/drive.ps1 must belong to a screen here, and every screen must list both runners and all three scales. Add a screen here when you add a panel; CI fails otherwise. 'shots' are the file stems the driver writes (no extension).

panelShotsOutsideTheMatrix._why: Shot-Panel names that are variants of a screen above (same window, other state or entry point).
